name: Premchand Panku
bio: I like building things and then figuring out why they broke. Most of my time goes into backend systems, Go, Python, TypeScript, and lately a lot of curiosity around AI and how things work under the hood.
Outside code, I like movies, music, good interfaces, and little creative experiments. I'm usually happiest when I'm learning something new or making something that didn't exist a few hours earlier.
